title: zPansitoA's PvP Pack!
description: A minecraft resource pack made for PvP but useful in Survival and Multiplayer!
body:
# **_¡zPansitoA_'s PvP Pack!**
**_For more updates join my discord or RageIP's server (unstable smp stuff) the link is below_**
- https://discord.gg/tBeezfPBK
- https://discord.gg/MRSU5YRzdQ


zPansitoA_'s PvP Pack is a resource pack designed to improve the Minecraft PvP experience while keeping the original vanilla style. It adds cleaner textures, better visibility, and visual improvements that help during combat without completely changing the game's appearance.

✨ Features
- Knocback and (Breach, Density) Indicator
- Ore Borders
- Enhanced particles and effects
- Better visibility during PvP fights
- Refined GUI and inventory icons
- Improved items textures with animations
- Vanilla-friendly style
- Lightweight and optimized for performance
- Compatible with survival, PvP, and multiplayer servers
- Tiny ViewModel
- No Explosion Particles
- Unobstructive Rain
- Clean Items
- And even **_MORE_**

  ![My Pack!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c8c0563e851202c3fe144c6a9a21eefe774b066c.png)
